title: Notification regarding final Answers Keys for the Written Examination for recruitment to the post of Library Assistant . .
text:
KEY LINES:


FULL TEXT:
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
AT IMPHAL
NOTIFICATION
Imphal, the 2P August, 2026
No. HCM/A-28/80-Estt./Vol-IV(Pt)/ lgggl : in pursuance of the Notification
of even number dated 31st July, 2026, inviting claims/objections against the provisionally
published Answer Keys, it is hereby informed to all concerned that the final Answer Keys
for the Written Examination held on 26th July, 2026, for recruitment to the post of
Library Assistant, are enclosed herewith as ANNEXURE-1.
(OJESH MOTUM)
REGISTRAR GENERAL
HIGH COURT OF MANIPUR
Copy to:-
1. The Principal Secretary to Hon'ble The Chief Justice, High Court of Manipur.
2. The Private Secretary to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Bimol Singh, High Court of
Manipur.
3. The Private Secretary to Hon’ble Mr. Justice A. Guneshwar Sharma, High
Court of Manipur.
,/The System Analyst, High Court of Manipur.
- with a request to upload the same in the Official Website of this Registry.
5. Concerned file/Guard file/Notice Board.
